posts.cooked:
here i have set 2 conditions
first condition is that when i click on the parent workspace it will not open any workspace it is frozen it will just dropdown and show the links of other doctypes
so you should keep the very first workspace out of this code as this will be your main workspace
then in js file we have 2 files one is for the link and the 2nd one is the parent to set the dropdown menu

**Now first of all add a new file in your custom app in public/desk/anyname.js **
and add this code

const workspaceRedirects = [
    { label: 'Link 1',       url: 'http://example.com', icon: 'fa-thumbs-up', color: '#0d6efd' },
    { label: 'Link 2',       url: 'http://example.com', icon: 'fa-thumbs-up', color: '#d4951eff' },
    { label: 'Link 3',       url: 'http://example.com', icon: 'fa-thumbs-up', color: '#6610f2' },
    { label: 'Link 4',       url: 'http://example.com', icon: 'fa-thumbs-up', color: '#fd7e14' },
];

const toggleOnlyParents = [
    { label: 'Parent Link Here',      icon: 'fa-thumbs-up', color: '#208aecff' },
    { label: 'Parent Link 2 Here',    icon: 'fa-thumbs-up', color: '#20c997' },
];

function applyCustomSidebarLinks() {
    if (!document.getElementById('fa-css')) {
        const faLink = document.createElement('link');
        faLink.id = 'fa-css';
        faLink.rel = 'stylesheet';
        faLink.href = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.0/css/all.min.css';
        document.head.appendChild(faLink);
    }

    const allLinks = [...document.querySelectorAll('a')];

    workspaceRedirects.forEach(({ label, url, icon, color }) => {
        const link = allLinks.find(a => a.textContent.trim() === label);
        if (!link || link.dataset.customRedirectSet) return;

        link.dataset.customRedirectSet = '1';
        link.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            window.open(url, '_self');
        });

        const existingIcon = link.querySelector('.sidebar-item-icon');
        if (existingIcon) existingIcon.remove();

        const iconHTML = `
            <span class="sidebar-item-icon">
                <i class="fa-solid ${icon}" style="margin-right: 8px; color: ${color};"></i>
            </span>`;
        link.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', iconHTML);
    });

    toggleOnlyParents.forEach(({ label, icon, color }) => {
        const parentLink = allLinks.find(a => a.textContent.trim() === label);
        if (!parentLink || parentLink.dataset.customToggleSet) return;

        parentLink.dataset.customToggleSet = '1';

        const container = parentLink.closest('.sidebar-item-container');
        const nested = container?.querySelector('.sidebar-child-item.nested-container');
        const dropIcon = container?.querySelector('.drop-icon svg use');

        const existingIcon = parentLink.querySelector('.sidebar-item-icon');
        if (existingIcon) existingIcon.remove();

        const iconHTML = `
            <span class="sidebar-item-icon">
                <i class="fa-solid ${icon}" style="margin-right: 8px; color: ${color};"></i>
            </span>`;
        parentLink.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', iconHTML);

        if (nested && label !== 'Parent ' && label !== 'Parent 2') {
            nested.classList.add('hidden');
            if (dropIcon) dropIcon.setAttribute('href', '#es-line-down');

            parentLink.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                const isHidden = nested.classList.toggle('hidden');
                if (dropIcon) {
                    dropIcon.setAttribute('href', isHidden ? '#es-line-down' : '#es-line-up');
                }
            });
        }
    });
}

setTimeout(applyCustomSidebarLinks, 1000);

frappe.router.on('change', () => {
    setTimeout(applyCustomSidebarLinks, 500);
});
